notes.title: "Kimamani☆Summer vacation" update!
notes.content:
We had a few reports of a small problem with the graphics when viewed via a Vive headset which has now been addressed. Sorry for the inconvenience!

Thanks for the reports and if you find any other issues, please report them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/689710/discussions/0/2579854400737584993/]here[/url]!

Happy summer vacation!
